SELECT u.company_id
FROM users u
INNER JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id AND c.status = 1
WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1

SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id, r.name, r.area_code, r.address, r.property_type,
r.monthly_rent, r.management_fee,
r.floor_plan, r.area_sqm AS area,
r.status, r.review_status,
CAST(r.agent_id AS CHAR) AS agent_id, agent.nickname AS agent_name,
r.published_at, r.updated_at
FROM rentals r
INNER JOIN companies c ON c.id = r.company_id AND c.status = 1
INNER JOIN users current_user_scope ON current_user_scope.id = #{userId} AND current_user_scope.company_id = r.company_id AND current_user_scope.status = 1
LEFT JOIN users agent ON agent.id = r.agent_id
WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId}
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT( '%', REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( TRIM(#{query.keyword}), '=', '==' ), '%', '=%' ), '_', '=_' ), '%' ) ESCAPE '='
AND r.area_code = #{query.areaCode}
AND r.property_type = #{query.propertyType}
AND r.status = #{query.status}
AND r.review_status = #{query.reviewStatus}
ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC

FROM stations s
